title: What We Are Going to Cover and PyTorch 2 Reference Materials

cues.en: All righty.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Let's have a broad overview of what we're going to cover to start with.
cues.zh: 先大致看看要介紹什麼。

cues.en: Of course, we're going to cover some new PyTorch 2.0 features, mainly focused around torch compile.
cues.zh: 當然，會介紹 PyTorch 2.0 的一些新功能，主要聚焦 torch.compile。

cues.en: We're going to get into that.
cues.zh: 會深入操作。

cues.en: Then we're going to set up a series of experiments to test PyTorch 2.0 improvements, the main one being speed.
cues.zh: 接著設定一系列實驗，測試 PyTorch 2.0 的改善，主要是速度。

cues.en: Then we're going to, of course, compare the results of the experiments and discuss some places of where you can learn more and of course, how we're going to do it.
cues.zh: 當然，也會比較實驗結果，討論去哪裡學更多。那要怎麼做？

cues.en: Well, we're going to do it like cooks, not chemists.
cues.zh: 我們會像廚師，而不是化學家。

cues.en: We're going to be cooking up lots of code.
cues.zh: 寫出大量程式碼。

cues.en: So with that being said, I'm going to meet you in Google CoLab and just in case you can get all the
cues.zh: 說到這裡，我們在 Google Colab 見。先說明一下，所有

cues.zh: 教材都能在 learnpytorch.io 找到，這裡有 PyTorch 2.0 入門。

cues.en: If you get stuck anywhere, this has got all the materials we're going to cover.
cues.zh: 如果哪裡卡住，這裡有接下來要介紹的全部教材。
